plan.title: SRC-TNC-013 Mandatory T&C on Single-Stage RFP

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation and keep Publish available.
Set the single-stage event type to RFP.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Apply a questionnaire template to the RFP stage.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Complete the buyer-side questionnaire requirements for the RFP.
Assign the evaluator required for publishing a technical stage.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFP create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory", verify both clauses show "Overridden by Mark all mandatory", and click Done; stop when the create screen is visible with the terms saved

steps.note: Configure and verify the two mandatory event clauses, which have no dedicated catalog step.
Add one QA test vendor to the event.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the event's RFP questionnaire and terms as the vendor.
Accept only the first of the two mandatory clauses.
Assert that submitting after accepting only one mandatory clause is refused or remains disabled.
